test_title: PYST 70: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have all correct spellings. Choose the sentence with the incorrect spelt word/words.

options.text: The old man said that what a man wanted was sympathy, and the judge said it was so.
Tommy telephoned a man in Cannes to act as second and McKisco said he wasn't going to be seconded by Campion.
That was still the state of things when the car got to the hotel.
Silas might have driven a profitible trade in charms as well as in his small list of drugs.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"profitible"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"profitable"**. (लाभदायक) • **Example:** Investing in real estate can be a highly **profitable** venture. • **"Profitible"** means something that brings profit or financial gain. The correct spelling, as mentioned, is **"profitable"**. (लाभदायक) • **Example:** The new business idea turned out to be very **profitable.** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1**: The old man said that what a man wanted was sympathy, and the judge said it was so. (बुजुर्ग आदमी ने कहा कि किसी आदमी को जो चाहिए वह सहानुभूति है, और जज ने कहा कि ऐसा ही है।) • **Example:** Sympathy is often what people seek in times of trouble. • **Option 2**: Tommy telephoned a man in Cannes to act as second and McKisco said he wasn't going to be seconded by Campion. (टॉमी ने कान्स में एक आदमी को फोन किया कि वह दूसरे के रूप में कार्य करे और मैककिस्को ने कहा कि वह कैंपियन द्वारा दूसरे नहीं होंगे।) • **Example:** Tommy's call to Cannes was crucial for the arrangement. • **Option 3**: That was still the state of things when the car got to the hotel. (जब कार होटल पहुंची तो स्थिति वैसी ही थी।) • **Example:** The situation remained unchanged as the car arrived at the hotel. 36:Tc5b, The correct answer is **Option 3**.
